entities.name: Chloro aza-lactam
observations: Reactant structure: CN1CCCN2C1=CC(Cl)=NC2=O; contains an activated heteroaryl chloride.

entities.name: Hydroxymethyl aryl ether
observations: Reactant structure: N#Cc1cc(CO)ccc1Oc1cccc(C(F)(F)F)c1; contains a benzyl alcohol and nitrile.

entities.name: NaH in DMF
observations: Close ORD analogues report NaH/DMF for heteroaryl chloride substitution by an alcohol-derived oxygen; reported yields include 50% after 30 h and 56% after 30 h. Exact substrate pair not located.

entities.name: Heteroaryl O-substitution
observations: The product connectivity supports displacement of the activated heteroaryl C–Cl by the alcohol-derived oxygen, forming an O-linked substituent; exact conditions remain unverified.
